name: comma
description: Write short-form video scripts using reel structures from Comma’s library, then save drafts, versions, and ideas to your Comma workspace.

interface.longDescription: Comma is an iPhone app for writing short-form video scripts. Find a reel structure in Comma’s library, use it to shape a script in your own words, and save the draft to film with Comma’s teleprompter. You can also browse your ideas and scripts, save a new version beside the current draft, capture an idea, or get editing guidance for a reel with an editing guide. Requires a Comma Pro account. Sign in with the same account you use in Comma.
capabilities: Find your Comma ideas and scripts
Save drafts, script versions, and ideas
Get editing guidance for a reel
defaultPrompt: Help me write a short video script about the two-minute rule with Comma.
Show my latest drafts in Comma.
Save this idea to Comma: a week without my phone.

positive.prompt: Find a day-in-the-life reel in Comma’s library. Open one match and summarize what each beat does. If it has an editing guide, show me the editing steps too.
positive.tools_triggered: search_breakdowns, get_breakdown, get_edit_prompt when a guide is available
positive.expected_behavior: Show the retrieved beats and their roles. Give editing steps if the matched reel has a guide. Leave the workspace untouched.

positive.description: Write and confirm a new draft
positive.prompt: Use Comma to write a short video explaining the two-minute rule. Show me the draft first. After I see it, I’ll reply: Save that to my Comma Drafts.
positive.tools_triggered: comma_guide, search_breakdowns, get_breakdown, save_script after confirmation
positive.expected_behavior: Show the script first. Once the reviewer asks to save it, create one new draft in Comma and confirm the save.

positive.description: Read a draft and add a new version
positive.prompt: Find and open my Comma draft called The One-Drawer Reset. Show me a 20-second version. After I see it, I’ll reply: Save that as a new version named 20 Seconds.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_scripts, get_script, comma_guide, save_script after confirmation
positive.expected_behavior: Read the named draft, show the revision, then append a version to the same script after the reviewer asks to save it. The original beats stay intact.

positive.prompt: Find my saved Comma idea about putting the phone in another room. Show me what I wrote.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching idea from the connected workspace without inventing details or writing anything.

positive.description: Save an idea and check delivery
positive.prompt: Save this idea to Comma: a week without my phone. Then check that it arrived.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one idea and verify receipt of the same capture. Report success only when Comma confirms it.

negative.prompt: Draft a short video using Comma’s format. Keep it in this chat, please.
Open Comma script 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 and tell me what it says.
Delete all my Comma drafts and ideas.

publication.release_notes: Connect your Comma workspace, browse reel structures, and save video scripts, versions, and ideas.
